name: EPFL
description: EPFL (École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne) is a federal institute of technology in Lausanne, founded in 1853 and a federal institution since 1969. It has over 10,000 students in engineering, natural sciences, architecture and computer science.
whyIncluded: Most EPFL master's programmes are taught in English, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: EPFL 'Financing your studies' approximate budget for foreigners, monthly over 12 months: housing CHF 900; food CHF 600 (CHF 20 a day); transport CHF 60 (monthly pass); personal = supplies CHF 100 + radio/TV fee CHF 30 + other expenses (personal effects, phone, outings, sports) CHF 250. Excludes health insurance (CHF 113-120), liability insurance (CHF 10), residence tax (CHF 37) and tuition. EPFL's own total is CHF 25,219 a year (CHF 2,107 a month) without tuition; the page is undated and was read in September 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.notes: Tripled tuition CHF 2,190 per semester x 2 for foreign students who move to Switzerland to study, from autumn 2025 (CPI-indexed every four years from 2029). Compulsory semester contributions: sports CHF 16 + social fund CHF 9 = CHF 25 x 2; the CHF 25 AGEPoly membership is refundable on request so excluded. One-off application fee CHF 150 for foreign certificates (from EPFL's 'Financing your studies' page). 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in French.
